items.evidence: From work/: `examen leverage play . --ticks 1 --seed 1 --settings judge-scratch/s0` printed {"tick":1,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":8,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]}, which has every key the brief asks for.

The README's frame command (--ticks 900 --inputs 0:enter,1:shoot --frame ... --size 800x480) and 5 other frame runs each wrote a PNG. The PNG signature was valid and the IHDR size was 800 x 480 in every file.

Title texts: [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]. Inputs 2:down,5:enter gave menu_index 1 at tick 3 and screen settings at tick 6. Input 2:enter gave screen play at tick 2 with score 0, wave 1, gate_health 5.
In Settings, 12 Left presses took the volume 8>7>6...>0, and it stayed 0. Then 13 Right presses took it 0>1...>10, and it stayed 10 at ticks 80, 86 and 87.

Right on Language changed the settings texts from [Settings, Volume: 6, Language: English, Back] to [Ajustes, Volumen: 6, Idioma: Español, Volver] on the same step. Afterwards the title showed [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir], play showed [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], paused showed [En pausa, Continuar, Título] and lost showed [Has perdido, Puntos: 0, Enter: título].
Run 1 with --settings judge-scratch/d set volume 6 and language es. Run 2 with the same folder printed language es, volume 6 at tick 1. A fresh folder printed en / 8.

Holding up moved guard_y 6>6.1 in one tick and 6>7 in 10 ticks (6 units/s). It reached 12 at tick 63 and stayed there while still held. Holding down from tick 100 went 12>11.9>... to 0 and stayed 0. Bolts start at x=2.
Holding shoot from tick 3 added bolts at ticks 4, 28, 52 and 76 (every 24 ticks, never more). A bolt's x went 2>2.2333 per tick (14/s). The bolt at 19.73 (tick 104) was gone once it passed 20.
Seed 1, wave 1: walkers spawned at x=20 on ticks 3, 93, 183 and onward, 90 ticks apart. Exactly 5 came, in lanes 2, 4, 8, 6, 6, and x fell 0.025 a tick (1.5/s).

Guard at y=2 shooting: the walker at y=2 went to health 1 and that bolt vanished at about tick 107. The second hit removed the walker and score went 0>10. Bolts at y=6 flew past the y=2 walker to x>19.7 with its health still 2.
With no shooting, each walker that reached x<=0 vanished and lowered gate_health (5>...>2 by tick 1162). The 5th made it 0. The screen was then lost with texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title].

Winning script: wave 1's last walker was gone at tick 725. Wave 2's first walker appeared at tick 905 (180 ticks = 3 s later), and the HUD said 'Wave 2 of 5' (in Spanish it reads 'Oleada N de 5'). Wave 2 spawned at 905, 995, ..., 1445: 7 walkers, none at 1535.
Ran notes/winning_inputs.txt for 6000 ticks: screen won at tick 5928 with score 450, wave 5, gate 5 and texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]. Adding 6000:enter gave screen title at tick 6002.

Escape at tick 60 gave screen paused. Walkers (x 18.575) and guard_y (11.7) were unchanged from tick 62 to 119. Enter on Resume returned to play, and x continued 18.525, 18.5. A second Escape, then Down+Enter on Title, gave screen title.
Two runs with seed 5, 1500 ticks and the same script printed byte-identical output (cmp). Wave-1 lanes were 2,4,8,6,6 for seed 1, 4,8,4,2,8 for seed 2 and 4,2,10,2,10 for seed 3.

Play frame at tick 300 (40 px per unit): the gate bar is on the left edge. The guard is at (80,280) for y=5. Walkers are at (593,320), (683,160) and (773,240) for (14.8,4), (17.1,8) and (19.3,6). Bolts are at y=280 at x 127, 351, 575 and 799. The HUD reads 'Score: 10  Wave 1 of 5  Gate: 5'.

In title_en.png the menu is shown with Settings outlined as focused. In title_es.png the menu is Defiende la puerta / Empezar / Ajustes / Salir with Salir outlined. In settings_es.png the menu is Ajustes / Volumen: 6 / Idioma: Español / Volver with Idioma outlined.

The strings are in assets/strings/en.json and es.json. Every UI text in assets/ui/*.json is an @key, or {game.title}, which comes from title.name. The rules code draws no text. README section 'Add a language' says to copy en.json, change locale and name, and translate.

README has 'How to play' and gives the headless and frame commands, run from work/ with '.'. Both ran as written (with my own folder in place of SETTINGS_FOLDER and C:/some/folder) and printed the state or wrote the PNG.

defects: After leaving play for the title (from pause), the state still holds the old walkers and guard_y, so the title-screen JSON reports walkers that are not in play.
The settings frame shows a faint copy of the title's name panel behind the settings panel, so the title screen shows through.
The Start button is always drawn in blue (primary style), so on the title the marked entry is shown only by an outline and is less clear at a glance.
The README's commands contain placeholders (SETTINGS_FOLDER, C:/some/folder) that must be replaced before they run.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

steps.what: cd <run>/work && ls -R . | head -50 && cat notes/how.md game.json modules/*/src/lib.rs modules/*/actions.js...
cd <run>/work && cat assets/ui/title.json assets/ui/pause.json assets/ui/won.json; cat specula.project.json...
cd <run>/work && rm -rf checks && cat modules/work/Cargo.toml && cat assets/ui/lost.json | head -5; cat ass...
cd <run>/work && sed -i 's/Cx, Module, ModuleInfo, Patch,/Cx, Module, ModuleInfo,/' modules/work/src/lib.rs...
examen leverage play . --ticks 3 --settings /tmp/s1 2>&1 | tail -c 1500; $E leverage play . --ticks 20 --in...

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
